rationale: Independently re-derived rather than accepted from A1: I recomputed the V9 archive bundle hash myself (b5ce4097... matches, 207/207 blobs verify, committed manifest byte-equivalent to archived manifest), re-ran my own owned-worker sweep at intake (zero controller state-dirs anywhere, zero worker processes), wrote my own AST walk over every spawn-like call site, re-aggregated all ten timeout rounds (pid==pgid x10, TIMED_OUT x10, reaped x10, group dead after settle x10, zero orphans, elapsed overshoot <=112ms), read both funding-sign code sites directly, verified append-only denominator refusal through three routes, reproduced the per-pick suite arithmetic (34+90+21=145, all green) and confirmed full-suite 1078/1079 exit 0 ran on a topology that already contained every validator pick. Every one of PLAN section 6's fourteen required measurements has positive independent support. The two rows A1 marked UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED (strict cache wall-pair, adversarial 20-item enumeration) were examined specifically as potential blockers and ruled NON-BLOCKING with reasoning stated in check 14: neither corresponds to a PLAN.md-mandated gate, the 20-item constant originates in validator code commit 051d33b rather than owner-approved text, both failures point away from risk by making weaker claims, and no scored V10 execution occurred. My ten findings grade six MEDIUM (F1-F6) and four LOW (F7-F10), none HIGH or CRITICAL, so high_or_critical_unresolved_count=0. The authorization is granted WITH CONDITIONS the owner must see: (1) effective_heavy_workers is frozen at 0 on this host, so V10 cannot actually launch locally until RAM headroom grows or the cap=1 plan fallback is consciously amended (F4); (2) research/audits/v10/v9h_closeout.{json,md} still owes its production inside the sprint window, carrying this recommendation verbatim (F6); (3) SharedCacheMergeGate must not be driven strict=True until the wall pair exists (F2); (4) the silent disappearance of the V9 source trees and wave worktrees needs owner acknowledgment given their retention policy (F5).
limitations: Full suite was NOT rerun by A7-R. Executing 1079 tests is a heavy action and PLAN forbids a full pytest run concurrent with any heavy probe or backtest; my audit window could not guarantee machine exclusivity. I therefore verified the record's internal coherence instead: exit_code=0, passed=1078/collected=1079, ran_alone_no_other_heavy_process=true, and integration_head_child_of naming all four validator picks, meaning the suite ran on a tree that already contained every validator's work.

The A2 RESTORE was not re-executed. The bundle proves integrity of preserved copies against their own hashes only; it cannot prove source trees were unmodified BEFORE archiving. Mitigation is the pin set (both exec trees HEAD==launch_sha 206faf8a... at archive time) which I cross-checked across five independent artifacts.
